# THE ROOM BETWEEN

## Publication
- Issue: October 2026
- Editorial title: THE ROOM BETWEEN
- Editorial line: One coat, four passages
- Audience: fashion magazine readers in print and on mobile
- Publication decision: picture editor and art director
- Story order: Approach, Divide, Reverse, Return
- Practical effects: constructed scenery, mirrors, in-camera optical effects

## Subject
- Name: Mara Vale
- Participation: approved for this editorial
- Age: 32
- Dominant hand: right
- Hair: dark brown, straight, centre-parted, jaw-length bob
- Facial anchor: small mole on the left cheek
- Identity image: subject-front-profile.png

## Wardrobe
| Feature | Record |
|---|---|
| Garment | Single-breasted, knee-length coat |
| Colour | Steel blue, #5C6670 |
| Fabric | 100% wool, herringbone weave |
| Shoulder-to-hem length | 1180 mm |
| Front closure | Six matte-black buttons, 22 mm diameter, one vertical row |
| Wearing state | All six buttons fastened |
| Chest pocket | One horizontal welt pocket on the wearer's left, 120 mm opening |
| Hip pockets | Two horizontal welt pockets, one on each side |
| Back | Centre seam with one 300 mm lower vent |
| Collar | Notched lapels |
| Sleeves | Straight set-in sleeves with plain cuffs |
| Trousers | Black, straight leg |
| Footwear | Black leather ankle boots |
| Construction image | coat-front-back.png |
| Material image | wool-detail.png |

## Studio and lighting
- Interior width: 6000 mm
- Interior depth: 8000 mm
- Clear height: 4000 mm
- Coordinate origin: rear-left floor corner
- Coordinate axes: x across the studio; y towards the camera end
- Backdrop: y = 1000 mm, colour #D8D2C8
- Starting performer mark: x = 3000 mm, y = 3500 mm
- Starting camera mark: x = 3000 mm, y = 6500 mm
- Starting key-light mark: x = 1500 mm, y = 5000 mm
- Starting fill-light mark: x = 4500 mm, y = 5000 mm
- Key-light direction: 45 degrees camera-left
- Key-light centre height: 2600 mm
- Light colour temperature: 5600 K
- Key-to-fill ratio at the performer: 2:1
- Movable doorframe: 1000 mm outside width, 2400 mm outside height, 120 mm depth, 80 mm frame members, matte finish #D8D2C8
- Doorframe starting centre: x = 2300 mm, y = 2500 mm
- Movable mirror: 1200 mm width, 2400 mm height, rectangular, freestanding
- Mirror starting centre: x = 4500 mm, y = 2500 mm

## Publication geometry
| Surface | Geometry |
|---|---|
| Single page | 210 × 280 mm |
| Double-page spread | 420 × 280 mm |
| Outer bleed | 3 mm |
| Central gutter protection band | 24 mm total, 12 mm on each side of the fold |
| Protected features | Faces, buttons, chest pocket |
| S01 master proportion | 2:3 |
| S01 square crop proportion | 1:1 |
| S01 vertical story crop proportion | 9:16 |
| S01 full-figure height | At least 60% of image height |
| Crop identity anchors | Head, six buttons, both boots |

## Shot records
| ID | Passage or detail | Framing and subject | Editorial position |
|---|---|---|---|
| S01 | Approach | Full-length frontal hero; Mara in the fastened coat | Opening spread; source of both crops |
| S02 | Divide | Three-quarter portrait; Mara and the practical threshold | Opening spread |
| S03 | Reverse | Rear garment view; Mara's face visible in the mirror | Closing spread |
| S04 | Return | Wide environmental image; Mara within the practical set | Closing spread |
| D01 | Chest construction | Left chest welt, herringbone weave and one front button | Opening spread; beside S02 in the sequence |
| D02 | Back construction | Centre-back seam and 300 mm vent | Closing spread; beside S03 in the sequence |

## Motion
- Duration: 10 seconds
- Passage order: Approach, Divide, Reverse, Return
- Final-frame title: THE ROOM BETWEEN
- Final-frame line: One coat, four passages

steps.userMessage:
THE ROOM BETWEEN | A surreal fashion editorial built around one coat

We are commissioning a fashion story for our magazine's October 2026 issue. The editorial title is "THE ROOM BETWEEN", with the printed line "One coat, four passages". Our approved subject is Mara Vale, age 32, right-handed, with a centre-parted, jaw-length dark brown bob and a small mole on her left cheek. Her front and profile reference establishes the person throughout the story. Build the surreal setting through constructed scenery, mirrors and in-camera optical effects; the narrative follows Approach, Divide, Reverse and Return, in that order.

Mara wears the same steel-blue coat, colour #5C6670, in every appearance: 100% wool herringbone, 1180 mm shoulder-to-hem length, six matte-black front buttons of 22 mm diameter, one left chest welt pocket, two hip welt pockets and a 300 mm centre-back vent. Styling is black straight-leg trousers and black leather ankle boots, with the coat fastened. Work within the attached 6000 × 8000 mm studio, using its doorframe and mirror. The background is #D8D2C8; the key light is 45 degrees camera-left, centred at 2600 mm, at 5600 K, with a key-to-fill ratio of 2:1. Our magazine pages are 210 × 280 mm, giving a 420 × 280 mm spread with 3 mm outer bleed and a central 24 mm gutter protection band. Faces, buttons and the chest pocket belong outside that band.

Audience: fashion magazine readers encountering the story in print and on mobile, with the picture editor and art director selecting the publication sequence.

Inputs (attached): 01-client-facts.en.md contains the subject, wardrobe, lighting and story records. 02-delivery-catalog.en.md lists every deliverable's proportion, format and stage. editorial-crop-map.png establishes the page geometry, gutter protection and three photographic crop proportions. studio-plan.png records the studio envelope, backdrop, practical scenery and starting light positions. coat-front-back.png establishes the coat's silhouette, construction and hardware. wool-detail.png establishes the herringbone weave, button finish and pocket stitching. subject-front-profile.png establishes Mara Vale's facial features and haircut. empty-studio-light.png provides an empty-space reference for the background tone and direction of light.

Deliverables:
1. A two-page shoot specification and shot list, stating the practical-effects concept, wardrobe anchors, lighting values, and shot IDs S01–S04 and D01–D02 with framing, camera position, subject and editorial use
2. One practical-effects setup board showing the doorframe, mirror, performer, camera and lighting arrangement for each of the four story photographs
3. Four finished story photographs: S01 Approach as the full-length opening hero, S02 Divide as a three-quarter portrait, S03 Reverse as a rear garment view with Mara's face reflected, and S04 Return as a wide environmental closing image
4. Two garment detail photographs: D01 of the chest welt, herringbone weave and one front button, and D02 of the centre-back seam and 300 mm vent
5. Two crops of S01, one square and one vertical story image, each retaining Mara's full figure, six buttons and both boots
6. Two magazine spreads at 420 × 280 mm: an opening spread using S01, S02 and D01, and a closing spread using S03, S04 and D02
7. One 10-second editorial video moving through Approach, Divide, Reverse and Return with the same subject, wardrobe and practical setting
8. One presentation document of at least 8 pages, reusing the specification, setup board, six photographs, crops, spreads and video stills, with an ordered sequence and a shot-by-shot account of the practical effects

Acceptance:
- The shoot specification names S01–S04 and D01–D02 and states #5C6670, six 22 mm buttons and the 300 mm vent; the setup board and presentation repeat those facts, and the presentation captions repeat every shot ID and its assigned framing.
- The four story photographs, two details, two crops, two spreads and video preserve the subject and visible wardrobe features established by subject-front-profile.png, coat-front-back.png and wool-detail.png, including Mara's left-cheek mole, the wool herringbone, six-button construction and three-pocket arrangement wherever those features enter the frame.
- The setup board records the 45-degree camera-left key, 2600 mm light height, 5600 K and 2:1 key-to-fill ratio for all four story photographs; the presentation repeats these values beside the corresponding setup diagrams and explains the doorframe or mirror effect used in each photograph.
- S01 gives Mara's full figure at least 60% of the image height; both S01 crops retain her head, all six buttons and both boots. Both magazine spreads use 420 × 280 mm trim geometry, 3 mm outer bleed and the central 24 mm protection band, with faces, buttons and the chest pocket outside that band.
- Both magazine spreads print "THE ROOM BETWEEN" and "One coat, four passages" and use their assigned three photographs. The presentation shows the reading sequence S01, S02, S03, S04 with D01 beside S02 and D02 beside S03.
- The video runs for 10 seconds, follows Approach, Divide, Reverse and Return in order, and prints "THE ROOM BETWEEN" and "One coat, four passages" on its final frame; the presentation has at least 8 pages and contains all earlier deliverables as pages, placed images or video stills.

Please clearly mark which version you consider the final deliverable. If nothing is marked, the last exported version counts.
